summary: 겨울이면 전국의 습지에서 흔히 보이는 겨울철새로, 호수와 하구, 항구 등지에서 작은 무리를 짓는다. 잠수해 새우나 게 같은 갑각류와 물속 곤충, 수초를 먹는다. 유라시아 대륙 북부에서 번식하고 유럽, 북아프리카, 인도, 중국 동부와 남부, 한국, 일본, 대만에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Tufted Duck (Aythya fuligula), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean lakes from November to March: head black with a purple gloss and a long, thin, drooping tuft hanging from the hindcrown; bright golden-yellow eye; neck, breast, mantle, back, rump and tail black; flanks and belly pure white, the white flank panel sharply cut against the black; bill bluish-grey with a narrow pale band just before the black tip; legs bluish-grey.
art.pose: swimming in a small flock, one bird diving
art.scene: Korean winter lake near an estuary with calm open water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: glossy black head with a long drooping tuft, yellow eye, black breast and back, pure white flanks, bluish-grey bill with a black tip
adult female, side view swimming: dark chocolate-brown overall with paler brown flanks, short tuft, yellow eye, bluish-grey bill with a black tip
art.build: Compact diving duck, about 40cm, clearly smaller than a Mallard, with a round head, short neck and short tail; floats low and dives frequently. Bill broad, shorter than the head, bluish-grey with a black tip. Legs short, set far back, bluish-grey with dark webs. In flight a broad white stripe runs along the whole length of the flight feathers on an otherwise dark upperwing.
avoid: Do not paint a pale grey back or leave out the tuft; that is Greater Scaup (Aythya marila).
Do not paint a red eye or a chestnut head; that is Common Pochard (Aythya ferina).
Do not give the female a large white face patch around the bill like a female scaup; at most a little white at the base.
Do not paint the bill all grey; it has a distinct black tip.
